subject: english
question:
**A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.**

Ravi said, "I like this pen."

options.text: Ravi said he liked that pen.
Ravi said he like that pen.
Ravi said he liked this pen.
Ravi said he likes that pen.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Ravi said he liked that pen .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is in direct speech: Ravi said, "I like this pen."
 
• When converting to indirect speech, the tense of the verb changes as the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense. Thus, "like" changes to "liked."
 
• The demonstrative pronoun "this" changes to "that" in indirect speech.
 
• Option 1 correctly reflects these changes: "Ravi said he liked that pen."

Correct sentence: *Ravi said he liked that pen.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Changes in tense while converting direct to indirect speech:**
 
 
• Present Simple → Past Simple
 
• Present Continuous → Past Continuous
 
• Present Perfect → Past Perfect
 
 
 
• **Changes in demonstrative pronouns:**
 
 
• "This" → "That"
 
• "These" → "Those"
